City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  July 13, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the 1st Floor, Finance Conference Room at
11:30 a.m.:

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Charles Meremikwu, Treasurer Department
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk

  Staff Present:  Toya Ferguson, General Service Coordinator
  Teresa Estrada, Parks and Recreation
  Ismael Perez, Water Treatment Plant

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of June 29, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Ocean Blue Environmental Services, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  services provided at Darby and Vincent Park in the amount of $3,141.00. Motion carried
  unanimously

3. LittleJohn-Reuland Corp – Executive session to discuss to recommend payment for replacement
  parts at the Treatment Plant in the amount of $3,322.50. Motion carried unanimously

4. Konecranes – Executive session to discuss to recommend payment for inspection services of the
  Water Treatment Plant in the amount of $510.00. Motion carried unanimously

5. It’s Your Party Floral & Event Design – Executive session to discuss to recommend payment for
  services for Early Childhood Education Program in the amount of $125.00. Motion carried
  unanimously

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 11:41 a.m. Adjournment
